text:
Bremen’s median asking rent sits at 11.38 €/m² in June 2026, up 2.6 % year‑on‑year and 25.5 % over the past five years, placing the city 19th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The spread between the 25th and 75th percentiles (9.65 €/m²–13.24 €/m²) shows modest dispersion, while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 683 € per month.

The market remains balanced with a 2.0 % vacancy rate and 26  days on market; 29 % of listings are let within a week. Affordability is pressured – rent burden for two residents is 15.2 % and asking rents are 47 % above the 2022 existing rent of 7.75 €/m².

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 12.09 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 11.73 €/m² and 12.47 €/m², implying a 6.3 % increase.
